hotspots.rationale: Single-connection HubState facade preserves public state and transaction ownership. Bounded 2026-10-02 scope is wiring QueueVisibilityState, forwarding notice/capacity options, and calling notice preparation/supersession inside existing admission and result/failure transactions. queue_visibility.py owns reason/supersession queries, provider_queue_capacity.py owns shared capacity reads, and task_activity_binding.py owns live activity identity. Further facade extraction is deferred until the transaction API changes; moving these calls would split atomic job/input/notice commits.

hotspots.rationale: Bounded 2026-10-02 scope is two optional notice/capacity arguments and a delegated notice-preparation call in the existing admission transaction. QueueVisibilityState owns notice policy; HubState must commit the job, input receipt, topic sequence and notices together, rolling all back on preparation failure. Keep that transaction in one method rather than extracting only its final write and weakening replay/rollback review.
hotspots.reopen_event: Any growth, new admission lifecycle branch, additional provider/notice policy, or a change to the atomic job/input/notice transaction.
